name: Beggar's Haunt
summary: At Beggar's Haunt, Forsaken agents watch the eastern approaches from an old Stormwind tower. It rises on a hillside in northeastern Duskwood, near the mountain road to Deadwind Pass.

sections.title: A Watchtower in the Shadows
sections.body: Beggar's Haunt overlooks the hills east of Manor Mistmantle. Stormwind once kept guards in this tower to watch the kingdom's eastern approaches. As Duskwood fell into gloom, patrols withdrew to Darkshire and left the tower to the elements. Forsaken agents now use the ruins to study the region and watch it from within Alliance territory. They include members of the Royal Apothecary Society and the Deathstalkers.

sections.title: Knight's Hollow and the Forgotten Dead
sections.body: A twisting path behind the tower descends to Knight's Hollow, a secluded pool and waterfall. An unmarked grave lies there between two hooded stone statues like the guardians beside the Dark Portal. Nearby graves include the burial place of an Unknown Soldier. They recall forgotten clashes along this frontier, fought long before the Forsaken took the watchtower.

faq.q: Why are there Forsaken at Beggar's Haunt?
faq.answer: Agents from the Undercity have claimed the abandoned tower, including Apothecary Faustin of the Royal Apothecary Society and Deathstalker Zraedus. They watch Alliance movements and quietly conduct experiments far to the south.

faq.q: Was this tower originally built by the Forsaken?
faq.answer: No. Stormwind built the tower as a scout outpost. When local defenses faltered and the region became Duskwood, the Stormwind Guard abandoned it. Forsaken scouts later seized the empty tower.

faq.q: What is the strange grave behind the tower?
faq.answer: Knight's Hollow lies down the path behind the haunt. Its secluded waterfall pool has an unmarked grave framed by hooded guardian statues like those beside the Dark Portal.

faq.q: Is Beggar's Haunt hostile to Alliance travelers?
faq.answer: Yes. The Forsaken agents at the tower are seasoned and will strike down Alliance travelers who come too close to their hillside refuge.

angles.text: Forsaken agents inside an old Stormwind scout tower just off the main road signal Horde infiltration on Darkshire's doorstep.
As a Forsaken, you have a secluded, dangerous foothold deep in the human lands of the south.
